items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: a fellow named Red used to be -- hey, what you want, kid? I said, 'I want my money' and finally I got it all.

ctx.x: Yes, Lena Horne. Sing it to Lena Horne, 'I'm gonna love you as long as I love, da, da, da ... yep. Then they had another band number, you know, all the men. 'Here Goes a Fool In Love.' I arranged those two numbers, I charged the man $150, and I had to go up every -- you know, every time trying to get the money. He'd pay me a little, a fellow named Red used to be -- hey, what you want, kid? I said, 'I want my money' and finally I got it all.
It's funny how we have to struggle for our money in show business.
